authored_narrative.episode_purpose: Ten episodes in, this Story stops tracking change and starts simply observing what the change settled into — Gonagi and Dana moving through spaces that once tested them, now indistinguishable from anyone who has always belonged there.

scene_spirited_away_parental_transformat.purpose: A space built around the idea of transformation holds nothing left to transform — Gonagi passes through it exactly as settled as before entering, which is itself the clearest evidence the arc completed several episodes ago.
scene_spirited_away_parental_transformat.stakes: whether a Story can keep finding new things to say about a character who has finished changing
scene_spirited_away_parental_transformat.opposing_force: none — this scene's only real tension is the reader's expectation that one should exist

scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0048.purpose: A memory-shaped space, encountered without the weight memories usually carry in this Story — it registers, and passes, the way any ordinary moment does.
scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0048.stakes: whether familiarity has quietly become the entire content of the relationship this Story tracks
scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0048.opposing_force: nothing external; if there is tension here it is only in naming that nothing needs answering anymore

shot_spirited_00369.intent: A plain, functional shot — no echo, no held stillness, no visual argument being made. The Story's visual language has settled the way its characters have.

shot_spirited_00377.intent: A brief pass-through composition, giving the moment exactly as much weight as it needs and no more.
